crop.notes: Includes the 'AMUSEMENTS.' section head, the 'Special Dispatch' line and the 'A MILL IN PROSPECT' item in full.

ocr.notes: Transcript omits the dateline 'CINCINNATI, May 8.' and the subhead; otherwise matches.

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican carried a Cincinnati dispatch of May 8 saying Tom Allen was expected there that night and would go straight into training at the Buckeye House, near the city, for his fight with McCoole.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'The Missouri Republican—St. Louis, May 10, 1869'. Dispatch is dated Cincinnati, May 8.

facts.fact: Allen was expected in Cincinnati on May 8, 1869, to go into training at the Buckeye House, near the city, for his fight with Mike McCoole

notes: The current summary says he 'arrives'; the dispatch says he was expected that night.
